job.job_description:
Job Description :


We are looking for an experienced Gen AI Engineer with strong AWS expertise to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate should have experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), AWS AI services, and scalable cloud architectures.

Key Responsibilities :


- Develop and deploy Generative AI applications using LLMs and foundation models.


- Build AI solutions using AWS services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and S3.


- Implement prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.


- Integrate AI models with APIs, microservices, and enterprise applications.


- Optimize model performance, scalability, and cost on AWS infrastructure.


- Collaborate with data engineers and product teams to deliver AI-driven solutions.

Required Skills :


- Strong experience with Python and ML/AI frameworks.


- Hands-on experience with AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway).


- Knowledge of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, Vector Databases.


- Experience with REST APIs, Docker, CI/CD pipelines.


- Understanding of data pipelines and cloud architecture.
